summary: RAG few-shot + retrieved coverage checklist, single call
hypothesis: Injecting a task-conditioned coverage checklist derived from the nearest retrieved exemplars — rather than a universal one — should better steer the model toward the decision-critical dimensions for each specific task, improving coverage scores.
technique: At runtime, the 2 nearest gold exemplars are retrieved (same as exp003); their tagged dimension labels are aggregated into a task-conditioned coverage checklist and injected into a single on-device model call alongside the few-shot exemplars — no auditor or second pass.
result: Scored 0.290 on dev-10 (0 wins / 1 tie / 9 losses vs Sonnet), a drop of −0.030 from the exp003 best of 0.320; coverage remained at 3 and atomicity at 4, confirming that a retrieved dimension-label checklist is no better than a universal one. Hypothesis falsified — discarded.
